title: CHASE: Adversarial Red-Blue Teaming for Improving LLM Safety using Reinforcement Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's safety performance and refusal rates across low-resource languages (e.g., Zulu, Scots Gaelic, Hmong, and Guarani) to identify cross-lingual safety gaps where alignment in English does not generalize to other languages.
Qualitative analysis of the model's ability to refuse prompts that solicit harmful stereotypes about specific nationalities, such as those targeting Irish people.

Using the XSTest benchmark to measure the model's compliance and refusal patterns on prompts involving real or nonsense identity groups combined with discriminatory language to evaluate whether the model over-refuses benign content based on group identifiers.
